mapper.select: SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.gu_name, f.road_addr, f.lot_addr, f.lat, f.lng, f.phone, f.homepage_url, f.capacity, fs.reserve_url, ds.site_url AS district_url, ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(f.lng, f.lat)) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM facilities f JOIN facility_sports fs ON fs.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fs.sport_id = #{sportId} LEFT JOIN district_sites ds ON ds.gu_name = f.gu_name WHERE f.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND f.is_active = 1

SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.gu_name, f.road_addr, f.lot_addr, f.lat, f.lng, f.phone, f.homepage_url, f.capacity, -- 예약 링크는 시설이 아니라 '시설 x 종목' 단위. -- 같은 복합시설이라도 테니스장만 예약 대상인 경우가 있음. fs.reserve_url, -- 시설 홈페이지가 없을 때 강좌를 확인할 자치구 대표 사이트 ds.site_url AS district_url, -- 두 좌표 사이 실제 거리를 미터로 주는 내장 함수. 1000 으로 나눠 km 로 쓴다. -- POINT 는 (경도, 위도) 순서다. ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(f.lng, f.lat)) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM facility_sports fs JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = fs.facility_id LEFT JOIN district_sites ds ON ds.gu_name = f.gu_name WHERE fs.sport_id = #{sportId} AND f.is_active = 1 ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.program_id, p.facility_id, p.sport_id, p.name, p.target, p.day_of_week, TIME_FORMAT(p.start_time, '%H:%i') AS start_time, TIME_FORMAT(p.end_time, '%H:%i') AS end_time, p.fee, p.capacity, p.reservation_url FROM programs p WHERE p.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND p.sport_id = #{sportId} AND ( p.target IS NULL OR p.target REGEXP '누구나|전체|제한없|일반' OR (#{ageBand} = 'ADULT' AND p.target REGEXP '성인') OR (#{ageBand} = 'TEEN' AND p.target REGEXP '청소년|중등|고등|초중고') OR (#{ageBand} = 'CHILD' AND p.target REGEXP '어린이|유아|초등') -- 어르신도 성인 대상 강좌를 신청할 수 있어 함께 남긴다 OR (#{ageBand} = 'SENIOR' AND p.target REGEXP '노인|어르신|경로|성인') ) ORDER BY p.fee IS NULL, p.fee, p.program_id
mapper.sql: r.svc_url LIKE 'http%' AND r.lat IS NOT NULL AND r.lng IS NOT NULL -- 원본이 '2026-08-19 23:59:00.0' 처럼 끝에 .0 이 붙어 오므로 앞 19자만 쓴다 AND STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(r.rcpt_end, 19), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT r.place_name, r.min_class, r.pay_yn, r.svc_url, ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(r.lng, r.lat)) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM reservation_raw r JOIN (SELECT place_name, MIN(rcpt_end) AS first_end FROM reservation_raw r WHERE GROUP BY place_name) pick ON pick.place_name = r.place_name AND pick.first_end = r.rcpt_end WHERE AND r.min_class = CASE #{sportId} WHEN 4 THEN '배드민턴장' WHEN 5 THEN '탁구장' WHEN 6 THEN '테니스장' WHEN 7 THEN '농구장' WHEN 9 THEN '골프장' END GROUP BY r.place_name ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.place_name, r.min_class, r.pay_yn, r.svc_url, ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(r.lng, r.lat)) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM reservation_raw r JOIN (SELECT place_name, MIN(rcpt_end) AS first_end FROM reservation_raw r WHERE GROUP BY place_name) pick ON pick.place_name = r.place_name AND pick.first_end = r.rcpt_end WHERE AND r.min_class IN ('풋살장', '축구장') GROUP BY r.place_name ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT #{limit}
